data.control_account: 1.04.03.01.04.02 - CS_HW Launch Ex Subsystem Production Manufacturing
data.leadership_messages:
1. This includes all efforts related to the fabrication, assembly, inspection, and acceptance testing of the hardware components defined by the approved design documentation.
2.No visibility into production rates, task durations, resource loading, or supply chain dependencies
3. Furthermore, the lack of formal handoff documentation (e.g., criteria for accepting a "build-to" package from design) introduces a significant risk of starting production with an immature design
data.rationale: The schedule loading readiness and integration assessments is Moderate based on the artifacts reviewed for this CA. There is moderate confidence in scope and logical hierarchy to requirements with vertical traceability, though detailed execution artifacts are still pending for a strong confidence rating.

areas.text: The WBS Dictionary provides a clear scope for this production and manufacturing task.

This manufacturing effort is correctly placed after the Increment 1 C&L Segment CDR (DC1.01.04), and its deliverables are a direct prerequisite for the Increment 1 C&L Segment PCA/Asset Ownership Transfer

It is functionally dependent on the Design Engineering team to provide complete and accurate "build-to" packages. It, in turn, provides the finished hardware to the Integration & Test (I&T) team (WBS 1.04.03.01.04.01) and the Quality Assurance team for verification. The IMP confirms this flow at a high level, but the execution-level handoff criteria are undefined.

data.products:
SOW Rev 9.0
NG Command Systems Control Account Rollup/COBRA Exports 31 July 2026
WBS Dictionary 24 July 2026
IMP Rev B
NG RAM 16 July 2026
data.concerns: Without visibility into the assumptions for production rates and durations, there is a risk of inefficient resource planning, schedule delays, and an inability to accurately forecast delivery dates for the Launch Ex hardware.
data.questions: Are there hard-linked IMS dependencies between the delivery of these manufactured assets and the start of I&T activities (WBS 1.04.03.01.04.01)?
data.integration: The items produced by this WBS/CA are individual products that must be integrated into a larger system. This manufacturing WBS must be aligned with the schedules for all other interfacing hardware products to ensure a complete subsystem can be delivered to I&T. While the IMP provides the overall program flow, a detailed IMS is needed to verify that the production schedules for all related components are properly synchronized.
